name: work-optional
description: Log your month in plain words and check whether you're on track. End-to-end encrypted: decrypted only on this computer with your passphrase.
long_description:
Tell Claude "this month: take-home 11,000, rent 3,200, groceries 600, 401k 1,958" and it is filed into the right categories of your Work Optional ledger. Ask for a year report, whether you're on track, or what a salary nets after tax.

Your data stays encrypted. With sync, this extension is another device on your Work Optional account: it reads and writes the same end-to-end-encrypted vault as the web app, so the server only ever holds ciphertext. Without a sync key it keeps an encrypted file on this computer only. Your passphrase is stored in your OS keychain by Claude Desktop and is never sent anywhere.

passphrase.title: Sync passphrase
passphrase.description: The same passphrase you set in the Work Optional web app (Data → Account & sync). Kept in your OS keychain; it unlocks your data on this computer and is never sent anywhere. At least 10 characters.

sync_key.title: Sync key (optional)
sync_key.description: Copy it from the web app: Data → Use it in Claude. Leave empty to keep data only on this computer (encrypted).

sync_url.title: Sync service
sync_url.description: Leave as is unless you run your own copy of Work Optional.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Where the data lives, sync sign-in, what has been logged.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Spending categories, line items, kinds of spending and income sources (EN / 中文).

tools.name: log_month
tools.description: Record or update one month: take-home, spending by category or line item, 401(k), net worth.

tools.name: set_budgets
tools.description: Set the monthly budget per spending category on the current plan.

tools.name: set_annual_expenses
tools.description: Keep the list of once-a-year bills: what to put aside monthly and what is coming.

tools.name: set_savings_goals
tools.description: Savings goals: target, deadline, saved so far — progress and what they need a month.

tools.name: recurring_bills
tools.description: Amounts that repeated last month (rent, insurance, salary…) to offer before logging.

tools.name: year_report
tools.description: A year's totals, savings rate, where money came from and went, plan vs actual and vs last year.

tools.name: on_track
tools.description: Net worth against the plan, and the age work becomes optional.

tools.name: paycheck_estimate
tools.description: Gross pay to take-home, tax by tax (2026).

tools.name: clear_month
tools.description: Remove one month, only when the user explicitly asks.

tools.name: sign_in
tools.description: Start signing in to an existing Work Optional account for sync.

tools.name: finish_sign_in
tools.description: Finish signing in with the emailed code or copied link.

tools.name: sign_out
tools.description: Forget the sync session on this computer.
